svg.title: The agentic closed loop
svg.desc: A loop of boxes. Top row, left to right: Observe, Reason (LLM, blue), Act. An arrow goes down from Act to Observe again, at the bottom right. Bottom row, right to left: Observe again, Compare, and Expected effect, which also feeds Compare from the left. An arrow goes up from Compare to Decide, in the middle. Decide has two exits: tag 1, a gray arrow right and up to Act; tag 2, a red arrow up to Reason (LLM).
